QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`... With the define set, it expands to `member` and the name is the bare field.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains both branches: without the define the renamed `private_` names are seen, and with it the bare names. It also ties the define to library and in-tree code versus outside application consumers.
